where.if: AND (n.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR n.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT n.id, n.category, n.title, n.content, n.is_pinned AS pinned, n.views, n.created_at AS createdAt, u.name AS writerName FROM notice n JOIN user u ON n.writer_id = u.id
ORDER BY n.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT n.id, n.category, n.title, n.content, n.writer_id AS writerId, n.is_pinned AS pinned, n.views, n.created_at AS createdAt, u.name AS writerName FROM notice n JOIN user u ON n.writer_id = u.id WHERE n.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE notice SET views = views + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice (category, title, content, writer_id, is_pinned) VALUES (#{category}, #{title}, #{content}, #{writerId}, #{pinned})
